scientific_integrity: The counterfamily is verified directly as algebra automorphisms. The only local-derivation property needed is independently reconstructed as a necessary finite-dimensional linear-algebra condition from the definition, rather than accepted solely from the source classification. The exponential obstruction is proved symbolically; finite computations are exact certificates, not empirical evidence.
scientific_limitations: The result refutes exponential surjectivity for \(\pi_3\) but does not classify the entire exponential image and does not address the analogous \(\pi_2\) statement. The motivating preprint is recent, so an unindexed contemporaneous correction remains a residual literature risk.
title: A one-parameter exponential obstruction for local automorphisms of \(\pi_3\)
